sn4.9:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn4.9:2.2: gamanīyo samparāyo kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ
sn4.9:2.4: yo bhikkhave ciraṃ jīvati so vassasataṃ appaṃ vā bhiyyoti.
sn4.9:3.1: atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
sn4.9:6.1: atha kho māro pāpimā. pe. tatthevantaradhāyīti.
